entries.10f99ca23977cce9: A reportable segment that delivers foods, mainly the Company's own, and household goods directly to individual members nationwide. It sells products made in the Production and Wholesale Business and other businesses, and goods purchased from outside suppliers, to members. Sales for the fiscal year ended March 2026 were ¥1,660 million (down 1.8% from the same period of the previous year), and operating profit was ¥35 million (up 18.0%). The securities report states that, although price revisions had an effect, the number of new members decreased against the background of growing consumer thrift-mindedness and other factors, the order rate fell, and sales decreased. Operating profit increased because, although sales decreased and personnel expenses rose, the effect of price revisions was joined by productivity improvements from improvements in picking operations and other areas. In addition, as a result of calculating the recoverable amount of fixed assets in light of changes in the business environment, an impairment loss of ¥143 million was recorded for this segment and the Chinese subsidiary combined. In November 2023, a new distribution center was built to respond to increased sales in the direct sales business.

entries.4a7c84800a3f9c5c: A reportable segment that makes and sells chicken, frozen processed foods, eggs, milk, and other products, mainly to direct-from-producer consumer cooperatives and home delivery companies. It is the segment with the larger sales to external customers of the two reportable segments. Sales for the fiscal year ended March 2026 were ¥6,622 million (up 5.7% from the same period of the previous year), and operating profit was ¥558 million (up 35.5%). The securities report states that, as demand grew for chicken, which offers a sense of value, against the background of consumers' thrift-mindedness, sales were strong, mainly of frozen processed foods, and sales increased, helped by the effect of product price revisions. Although there were higher costs for raw materials and packaging materials and higher personnel expenses, profit increased because the effects of sales expansion and price revisions were joined by productivity improvements at the frozen food factory and the meat factory. Customers are consumer cooperatives, mass retailers, retail stores, and others; as a share of consolidated sales, Green Coop Federation accounted for 21.5% and Seikatsu Club Consumers' Co-operative Union accounted for 16.8%.
